question: How much indemnity did we pay out during calendar year 2025, regardless of when the accidents happened?
final_text:
We paid £20,236,714.68 in indemnity during calendar year 2025. This is paid loss on a calendar basis, valued at 31 December 2025. It is net of recoveries (salvage and subrogation) and excludes ALAE. It covers all accident dates.

ANSWER: 20236714.68
